evidence.statement: The frozen blind CANDIDATE-0002 contains a 25-bp direct-orientation block CAGTAGAACCGGAACCACCGTGGAA at E. coli start0 3,070,430 and yeast start0 326,673.
Post-freeze annotation places this block at coding start0 789 in both fbaA and FBA1; it begins on a codon boundary in both implementations.
In coding orientation the block is TTCCACGGTGGTTCCGGTTCTACTG; its first 24 bases encode eight complete codons, FHGGSGST.
This is a literal conserved coding primitive inside two class-II fructose-bisphosphate aldolase implementations.

semantics.validated_identity: coding fragment within homologous class-II fructose-bisphosphate aldolase genes

unknowns: Whether the exact FHGGSGST-preserving nucleotide sequence is constrained primarily by protein function, RNA-level constraints, historical inheritance, or a combination.
